neighbours.label: the completing token of a few fixed technical compounds: 'acid rain', 'resistance training', 'prote-olytic' / 'prote-ase' / 'protein-ase' (a list, not heavy rain or training in general)
fire: Sulphur from the smelters fell on the lakes as acid rain for decades.
The gel showed that the precursor is proteolytically processed in the Golgi.
Older adults gained strength after twelve weeks of resistance training.
The new HIV drug belongs to the class of protease inhibitors.
Forests downwind of the power plants were badly damaged by acid rain.
A serine proteinase was purified from the venom of the snake.
Her coach replaced the long runs with resistance training twice a week.
Bromelain is one of several proteolytic enzymes found in pineapple.
quiet: Water from the hills fell on the lakes as steady rain for days.
The gel showed that the precursor is heavily glycosylated in the Golgi.

The new HIV drug belongs to the class of fusion inhibitors.
Forests downwind of the power plants were badly damaged by acid fumes.
A serine kinase was purified from the venom of the snake.
Her coach replaced the long runs with resistance bands twice a week.
